concepts.gloss_en: davar — 'word/thing'; used as בחינת יראה and בחינת מלכות across LM1:4, LM1:15
medaber — the 'speaking' (rational) being, one of the four levels (domem/tzomeach/chai/medaber); distinct lexeme from davar

members.note: מְדַבֵּר in LM1:4 (חי מדבר = speaking creature); different root-meaning than דבר, not an inflection of 'word'. LM2:72 proof cited is unclear/possibly mis-anchored

concepts.gloss_en: devarim — 'words' (plural), specifically וידוי דברים = confession, בחינת מלכות

members.note: plural; kept separate from דבר per under-merge preference — inflection may or may not be the same concept, and its usage here is specifically וידוי דברים

notes: Three distinct forms kept as three concepts. מדבר (medaber, the speaking being) is a different lexeme entirely and must not be merged with davar/devarim. דבר vs דברים (singular vs plural of 'word') left separate per the under-merge rule; a human may choose to unify them as one inflected concept, but the plural's usage here is narrowly וידוי דברים.
